title: Cutting chicken breasts into cutlets

diagram.alt: Cutting chicken breasts into cutlets: lay each breast flat with a hand on top and slice it horizontally through the middle with the knife level, giving two cutlets about three quarters of an inch thick; lay the cutlets on the rack with gaps between them so they roast instead of steaming.

how: Lay the breast flat on the board, thick end toward your knife.
Press a flat hand on top to hold it still.
Keep the knife level with the board and slice through the middle, from the thick end to the tail.
why: Two even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing dries out waiting on a thick end, and more edges means more browning.

title: Roll-cutting carrots

diagram.alt: Cutting carrots: trim the stem and halve the thick top third lengthwise; cut on an angle about three-quarters of an inch apart, rolling the carrot a quarter turn between cuts, shorter pieces at the fat end and longer toward the tip; lay the even chunks cut face down on the pan.

how: Trim the stem and halve the thick top third lengthwise.
Cut on an angle about ¾ inch apart, rolling the carrot a quarter turn between cuts.
Cut shorter pieces at the fat end and longer ones toward the tip.
why: Same-size pieces finish together, and the angled faces give more flat surface to brown on the pan.
